details.name: Bio Visage Detox & Remodeling Mansard Facial Treatment
details.description: Bio Visage is the cornerstone of a conceptual approach designed to deliver results beyond expectations. This exclusively professional, technology-driven concentrate normalizes skin functions through a precise synergy of specialized currents and active botanical extracts. The complexion is instantly brightened by advanced oxygenation, visibly reducing redness and dark circles. By providing a gentle lifting effect, Bio Visage restores contractility to every muscle fiber—leaving the face completely restructured, firmer, and radiantly luminous.

details.name: Ionix Red Carpet Ready Facial Treatment
details.description: Deep cellular rejuvenation and contouring, an advanced, non-invasive skin treatment that combines up to eight high-tech modalities such as diamond microdermabrasion, negative pressure/ lymphatic drenage, oxygen infusion & Ionized mist, ultrasound therapy, microcurrent & radiofrequency, LED light therapy.  An expression of exceptional to lift, tone and brighten the skin with zero downtime.

details.name: Regenerative Facial Treatment
details.description: Regenerative facial treatment utilizes lymphatic drenage massage, LED light in conjunction with topical infusion of collagen fibers, soluble collagen peptides and molecules along with regenerative products such as exosomes to provide an optimal environment for healing, tissue remodeling and regeneration.  Who can benefit from: Post surgery, laser treatments, chemical peels, burns, severe retinoid reactions.

details.name: VI Peel
details.description:
Medium-depth chemical treatment designed to improve skin tone, texture, and clarity while stimulating collagen production.Safe and effective for all skin types and tones, including darker complexions.
Generally well-tolerated , visible peeling typically begins around day two or three and resolves within a week.

details.name: PRX
details.description: Non-invasive,  biorevitalizing skin therapy, stimulate deep collagen and elastin production without causing surface-level flaking or downtime.

details.name: BioRePeel
details.description:
Helps clear active breakouts, reduce pore size, and smooth post-acne marks.
Gradually fades sun damage and evens out overall skin tone.
An innovative, two-phase chemical peel featuring trichloroacetic acid (TCA) designed to rejuvenate the skin with minimal downtime.
